requiredFindings.title: Complete the admission-bound recipe for the transaction and reader
requiredFindings.detail: The table defines B as the sum of its terms and promises every actual charge is covered, but required operations have no term. D is explicitly the set of committed directory rows, so its per-dir terms do not cover creation of the extra tree/ container, its final fchmod/barrier, or the final stage-directory barrier (steps 2 and 4.4-4.5). The generation.json term prices its owned bytes and P-1/P-2/P-3, but omits its required exclusive create at step 4.2. private_directory_stage_cost covers neither these child operations nor recursive barriers. The enumeration row covers readdir/status calls, while the cited D3a discipline separately charges descend_cost for directory opens/duplicates, streams and stack/name storage; those setup costs are absent. The recipe likewise leaves archive opening, custody checks, and V2 association-record reading/validation without a complete charge derivation. Item 6 refers back to these prices for its own opens, records and pin capability. This is still a partial operation inventory rather than the claimed complete computable admission bound, so R2-RF-5 is not fully resolved.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Add explicit fixed/container and metadata terms, including create_exclusive_directory_cost("tree"), tree finalization and the stage barrier, create_exclusive_regular_cost("generation.json"), bounded V2 record read/admission, and the chosen open/custody/traversal setup and owned-storage prices. Publish a priced traversal helper or an equal conservative recipe that includes descent and stream/stack setup, not only READ_COST. Complete the no-op/read/transfer branch recipes or name their distinct bounded formulas, including pin descriptor/state checks. Define checked count/size arithmetic and the authenticated release fields needed for the record-length term; B need not depend solely on TreeCommitment bytes. Keep borrowed evidence uncharged and distinguish reserved charges from separately executed work. Extend CI-T22 with a valid file-only tree (D=0), nested directories, metadata-only operations and a preexisting-generation verification path, independently enumerating every charged call/owned representation so actual charges are demonstrably bounded by the published recipe.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Spell out the effect/postchecks split and the reservation-shortfall route
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The suffix can be implemented with the selected API, but WorkLedger::effect charges effect + postchecks while ReservedPostchecks receives only postchecks. publish_exclusive_reserved itself spends the publication cost from that allowance. Assigning the rename cost only to effect would therefore leave it unavailable to the reserved helper, despite the outer charge. Also, this paragraph calls a suffix reservation shortfall install-budget, while item 8 and CI-T22 classify in-operation exhaustion through law 468. The initial B-versus-remaining admission check is a separate event.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: Give an explicit mapping, for example effect = zero and postchecks = the complete suffix cost when both publication and barrier use _reserved, plus a priced allowance for the additional recheck. Do not charge publication twice. Keep pre-acquisition B rejection as install-budget/request-rejected, and an unexpected later reservation failure on the existing operational Budget route. Make CI-T26 assert both the argument split and the exact route.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Do not equate unconfirmed name durability with guaranteed absence after a crash
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The sentence stating that a name not durably published is absent after a crash is stronger than the selected primitives establish. If the rename occurred but its parent barrier did not complete, the name can survive or disappear. The immediately surrounding uncertain-publication handling and three-way restart verification already provide the correct fail-closed behavior.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: Say a rename whose durability was not confirmed may be absent or present after restart. Retain the existing full-verification requirement and all three restart outcomes.
